plan.mechanism_change: Rank context evidence by observed status and score: feasible non-null scores ascending first, then infeasible failures, then unknowns. For task decisions select the two lowest-score feasible IDs plus one failure guardrail; mutation keeps the first ranked parent and construct keeps no parent. For meta, switch to repair whenever an infeasible training case exists and set evidence to best feasible, second feasible, failure, then next feasible or unknown. Guidance requires preserving the capacity-safe family and using the failure only as a constraint.
